title: OptimNVC QoL
description: It's just OptimNVC but with more QoL.
body:
> "**_OptimNVC_** adds optimization and client side voice chat. **_OptimNVC_**'s main reason why it was created is due to my potato that I call a PC struggles running Minecraft. First I tried playing only servers, then I downloaded only Sodium, then I realised. The more optimisation mods, the bigger performance! So I added all optimisation mods I knew about. If you want more optimisation mods to this let me know, as I am happy to update it."
-[OptimNVC](https://www.modrinth.com/modpack/optimnvc)

It's just that but with more Quality of Life mods such as AppleSkin. Version 1.0.0 and 1.0.0b1 are broken. QoL mods added for example are AppleSkin, Just Enough Items and Better Advancements.
